comment: PT terminology gate for validate:content. Each rule scans the listed locales of title/summary/clinicalNote/visitQuestion on non-placeholder cards (drafts and published). Patterns are JS regex sources compiled case-insensitively unless flags say otherwise. Keep this list tight: only terms with a real incident or a standing policy behind them.

rules.reason: cards must carry real translations, never the (EN+PT) shorthand
rules.suggestion: write the full translated text in each locale

rules.reason: no audience line inside card text (audience lives in front matter)
rules.suggestion: delete the line; the dual toggle already separates the readings

rules.reason: English racial term left untranslated in Portuguese text
rules.suggestion: doentes negros / pessoas negras (adapt to context)
